item.title: Keke Palmer Joins BET Board of Advisors: ‘Has Been a Part of My Journey for Many Years’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest update in the entertainment world. We've got some exciting news to share with you. BET, the iconic network, has just appointed a new member to its Board of Advisors. And it's none other than the talented Keke Palmer!"
[Short music transition]
Host: "Palmer, who has a long-standing relationship with BET, expressed her excitement about joining the board, saying it's 'especially meaningful' to her. She's looking forward to helping shape the future of BET and creating opportunities for the next generation of artists and entrepreneurs."
[Short clip of Keke Palmer's statement]
Host: "BET President Louis Carr believes Palmer represents the future of entertainment, bringing a unique combination of insight, creativity, and entrepreneurial spirit to the table. And she's in good company, joining a board that includes industry heavyweights like Bob Johnson, Queen Latifah, and LL Cool J."
[Short music transition]
Host: "This appointment comes at a pivotal moment for BET, as the network gears up for the 2026 BET Awards in Los Angeles. The ceremony promises to be an exciting one, with performances from Kehlani, Cardi B, and Doechii, and honors for Lauryn Hill, Teyana Taylor, and music executive Sylvia Rhone. Don't miss it – the BET Awards kick off at 8 PM EST / 5 PM PST on BET."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for now. Thanks for tuning in, and we'll catch you on the next update!"
